events.did: considered starting with Xavier Pascal, the boy he had tried to help on his first day there
events.quote_anchor: He scanned his choices. Perhaps he’d start with Xavier Pascal. The boy he’d tried to help his first day there.

events.did: reported that the team had acquired the target but lost two of their own
events.quote_anchor: “We acquired the target,” he said. “But lost two of our own.”

events.did: brought the target’s details up on her tablet, showing a young, attractive, blond woman named Jessica
events.quote_anchor: As he spoke, Helena brought up the target’s details on her tablet. A woman stared back, young, attractive, and blond.

events.did: said she stopped them with a look and killed them with a hatchet
events.quote_anchor: The soldier shook his head. “She stopped them with a look. She killed them with a hatchet.”

events.did: crossed toward the cell wall toward him and called him a traitor
events.quote_anchor: “A traitor,” she seethed. She crossed toward the cell wall—toward him—red eyes narrowing in anger.

events.did: ordered gas, and Helena opened the vents so smoke poured into the cell
events.quote_anchor: “Gas,” he said softly, and Helena reached the panel in his stead. The vents opened, and smoke poured into the cell.

events.did: put his hand on the EO’s skin and dragged her back, then let go and stumbled back
events.quote_anchor: On the floor, the woman gasped. Gabriel let go, and stumbled back, his hand numb and his head on fire.

events.did: shot the resurrected EO, and the right side of her head vanished into crimson mist
events.quote_anchor: He dragged in a breath and looked to the stone-faced soldier who’d shot her. Evanson.

relations.did: asked Gabriel whether they know that he is like her, an EO
relations.quote_anchor: “Do they know?” She pitched her voice higher. “Do they know that you’re like me?” she screamed.

relations.did: was Gabriel’s guard and walked in his wake
relations.quote_anchor: He rose and strode out of the office, Helena as always in his wake. Her guard—now his—fell in step behind them.

relations.did: was now the acting director, so the field agent reported to him instead of Gabriel
relations.quote_anchor: “Dr. Gray is now the acting director,” she said. “So you report to him.”

relations.did: shot the resurrected EO to protect Gabriel, following the order Gabriel gave to every one of his conversions
relations.quote_anchor: Evanson. Following the order he’d given to every one of his conversions.

numbers.quote_anchor: There were twenty-one EOs presently in EON, up from the nineteen there’d been when he was hired

numbers.did: had nineteen EOs when Gabriel was hired
numbers.quote_anchor: up from the nineteen there’d been when he was hired (alas, none of them were Victor Vale)

numbers.did: lost two of his own in the operation
numbers.quote_anchor: “We acquired the target,” he said. “But lost two of our own.”

numbers.did: tracked the EO to a house fifteen miles north of Merit
numbers.quote_anchor: “We tracked the EO to a house fifteen miles north of Merit…”

numbers.did: came back with one soldier gone and the other sagged back against the wall
numbers.quote_anchor: By the time Gabriel arrived, the soldiers had wrangled the new arrival into a cell. One was gone.
